The meaning / The movement

Brought near.

Corban is more than an expression through clothing. It is a commitment to a life of faith, generosity, and purpose.

01 / Our name

An offering.
A way of living.

Corban—from the Hebrew korban, also rendered qorban—means an offering, or “that which is brought near.” It speaks to drawing close to God through dedication, giving, and worship.

For us, that offering is our everyday life: our time, our gifts, our choices, and our care for others. Rooted in the example of Christ, we seek to live with generosity and dedicate what we have to God’s purpose.

Clothing, apparel, and accessories become a way to express that commitment. The meaning lives beyond the clothes, in the person wearing them.

02 / Our story

Still growing.
Still moving forward.

Our story is shaped by Philippians 3:12: the recognition that we have not arrived at perfection, and the choice to keep pursuing the purpose for which Christ has called us.

Corban embraces that ongoing journey. We are people learning to live our faith with intention—through service, humility, love, and the courage to take the next step.

03 / What guides us

S.A.L.V.A.T.I.O.N.

Our faith is rooted in salvation as a gift of God’s grace. These nine values guide how we live it.

Purpose over perfection.
Love through action.
